messages:
Eli (NewHaven): hi team — kicking off NewHaven onboarding. POC: Eli. Primary goals: ingest transformer telemetry, auto-summarize anomalies for ops, vector search for historical incidents, and hit 1k req/day pilot. Need owners, success criteria, and a compact 30/60/90 plan.

Marta (CSM): welcome Eli! I’ll run CS coordination and acceptance testing. Quick Q: any strict compliance or residency constraints we should log now?

Eli (NewHaven): EU data residency required; audit trail for summaries also required for 12 months. Renewal is tied to both accuracy and demonstrable cost per token improvements (we need to see a 20% cost delta vs baseline).

Rafi (Solutions Eng): I’ll own the integration. Two initial asks: schema for telemetry events and an example of the downstream dashboard queries. Also clarifying: summaries via chat vs batch generation — want to confirm expected latency envelope (P95 target).

Eli (NewHaven): sending 48h telemetry sample to S3: s3://newhaven-onboard/samples/48h.json. Latency target: P95 <700ms for single-device queries, accuracy >=91% on our gold prompts.

Priya (Enablement): enablement plan: day 2 developer walkthrough (hands-on), day 10 ops & runbook + one-hour office hours after pilot launch. I’ll attach a pre-read with required IAM roles and allowlist steps.

Sofia (Product): product follow-up: we want the summaries to include a "confidence" flag and structured tags (severity, probable-cause). Can we get that into acceptance criteria?

Marta (CSM): adding to acceptance criteria: - Summary accuracy >=91% on gold set, - P95 latency <700ms, - Confidence + tags present in 95% of outputs, - Pilot cost-per-1k-tokens <= baseline * 0.8, - EU residency & 12mo auditability confirmed.

Yara (Legal): noted. Please confirm if deletion-on-request is required; if audit retention and deletion conflict we may need a Private deployment conversation. Marta, capturing legal contact.

Eli (NewHaven): deletion on request required for specific customer IDs; otherwise 12mo retention for audit. VPC with KMS + export controls preferred initially.

Rafi (Solutions Eng): proposed milestone plan:
Week 0 (pre-kickoff): API keys, allowlist, confirm S3 access, and sample queries
Week 1: ingestion pipeline + embedding index + baseline gens for gold set
Week 2: prompt engineering, tags & confidence tuning + load testing (burst scenarios)
Week 3: canary pilot + monitoring dashboards + runbook handoff
Week 4: pilot wrap, acceptance tests, cost optimization pass (quantized variants)

Rafi (Solutions Eng): smoke curl (please run from your infra): `curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer <KEY>" -d '{"model":"rwd-chat-1","input":"Summarize anomaly for device 123"}'` — paste output in the kickoff thread.

Marta (CSM): proposing kickoff Thu 09:00 CET or Fri 14:00 CET. Who should be on the invite? (eng lead, security, product, legal, infra).

Eli (NewHaven): Thu 09:00 CET works. Attendees: Eli, Marco (Eng lead), Lila (Security), Sofia (Product), Yara (Legal), Rafi, Marta.

cal-bot: Meeting created: Thu 09:00 CET — "NewHaven  Redwood Onboarding Kickoff". Invite sent to attendees.

Priya (Enablement): I’ll post the pre-read to the calendar invite: checklist (API key, allowlist IPs, sample S3 payload, gold prompt set). I’ll also schedule the dev workshop and record it.

Marta (CSM): CS action items: collect allowlist, confirm retention + deletion mapping, capture baseline token costs, and finalize acceptance tests. Any other risks to call out now?

Eli (NewHaven): risk: burst storms cause spikes — will provide a 1h storm trace for load testing. Also want Redwood Optimize suggestions for quantization; cost target is tight.

Rafi (Solutions Eng): noted  we’ll run quantized pass during Week 4 and report quality delta. Also will add an automated eval harness for the gold set.

Marta (CSM): perfect. I’ll share the action tracker after the kickoff invite is accepted. See you Thu. :rocket:
